question:
Which of the following pairs of "river–tributary" is correct?

I. Tapi – Manjira

II. Krishna – Ghatprabha
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Manjira ​

 
 
• It originates in the Balaghat range of hills in Maharashtra and enters Karnataka before entering the state of Telangana. 
 
• It is the tributary of the river Godavari. Therefore statement 1 is **incorrect**.
 
 
 
• Ghataprabha River:
 
 
• It originates from the Western Ghats and is one of the important tributaries of the **Krishna **river. Therefore II statement is **correct**.
 
• It flows 283 km before joining the Krishna River at Chikksangam.
 
• Hidkal dam was constructed across the Ghataprabha river.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Krishna river is an east-flowing river that originates in Mahabaleshwar, Maharashtra. 

 
 
• It flows from Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The length of the river is around 1401 km long.
 
• It is the fourth largest river in India after Ganga, Godavari, and Brahmaputra.
 
• The left bank tributaries of Krishna are Bhima, Dindi, Paleru, and Musi.
 
• Whereas its right bank tributaries are Koyana, Panchganga, Dudhganga, Malprabha, Ghatprabha, and Tungabhadra.
 
 
 
• Tungabhadra is the largest tributary river of Krishna.
